summary: Iter106 — Full backend+frontend verification of NEW features: Trust-numbers landing strip, public SEO blog (list/detail/seed), super-admin Blog CRUD, tenant referral flow with FREE-MONTH reward (signup→pending referral, _grant_referral_free_month for both active-sub extension and banked path), affiliate summary API, AffiliateCard + /refer page copy. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS. Frontend Landing/Blog/BlogManager/AffiliateCard/ReferEarn all verified visually + interactively (create+delete UI blog article end-to-end).

issues: Copy still says 'You get ₹1000 credited to your Miracurl subscription — automatically applied on your next renewal.' This contradicts the new hero + reward-per-paying-salon copy which says '1 FREE MONTH'. Update step-3 text to match (e.g., 'We add 1 free month to your subscription automatically after their first payment').

3 identical duplicate rows named 'Test Owner / Miracurl Unisex Family Salon / Great support fixing our billing' are visible — leftover test seed data from prior iterations. Also triggers React 'Encountered two children with the same key' console warnings on the landing page. Recommend a cleanup + de-duplication in the testimonials list.

test_coverage_details.GET /api/public/platform-stats: PASS — returns salons/cities/bookings/invoices as ints (>=1 salon)
test_coverage_details.GET /api/settings/affiliate: PASS — requires Owner PIN; returns months_earned, free_months_banked, referrals, reward='1 free month per paying salon'
test_coverage_details.Referral signup: PASS — POST /public/signup-salon with ref=miracurl-marathahalli creates affiliate_referrals doc {status:pending, reward:free_month}
test_coverage_details._grant_referral_free_month (banked): PASS — for referrer w/o active sub, tenants.referral_free_months incremented by 1
test_coverage_details._grant_referral_free_month (extend): PASS — for referrer WITH active sub, subscription.end_date +30 days and tenants.subscription_end_date updated; banked NOT incremented
test_coverage_details.Landing trust strip: PASS — [data-testid=trust-numbers-strip] shows '19 Salons / 1 Cities / 112 Bookings processed / 225 Bills generated' before testimonials
test_coverage_details./blog list page: PASS — 3 blog cards with data-testid blog-card-<slug> for all 3 seeded posts
test_coverage_details.Super-admin BlogManager UI: PASS — Partners tab → BlogManager card → New article → title/content → Publish → row visible → Delete → row gone (full round-trip)
test_coverage_details.Tenant AffiliateCard: PASS — data-testid=settings-affiliate-card, heading 'Refer & Earn a Free Month' present
test_coverage_details./refer page: PASS — 'Get 1 FREE MONTH for every salon you invite', earned/referred counters, invite link, existing referral 'Pending first payment' badge

critical_code_review_comments: Copy inconsistency in ReferEarn.jsx 'How it works' step 3 still references '₹1000 credited' instead of the new 1-free-month reward. Update for consistency (users will get confused seeing both messages on the same page).

routes/auth.py::_record_pending_referral still writes 'credit_amount': AFFILIATE_REWARD_INR as a legacy field. Consider removing after next release or renaming to 'legacy_credit_amount' to avoid confusion — settings/affiliate no longer surfaces it, but it lingers in DB.

affiliate_referrals list on Partners panel shows 3 duplicate rows of 'Test Owner / Miracurl Unisex Family Salon' — indicates prior test data was not cleaned. Since referrer_slug is often identical for test signups, consider using r.id as React key AND running a one-time cleanup script for TEST_ prefixed / duplicate rows.
AffiliateCard/settings unlock requires Owner PIN both at Settings-page level AND inner card (two-step) — UX slightly redundant, though secure. Not blocking.
test_credentials: Used seeded admin+super creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No new tenants persisted (test cleanup ran).
seed_data_creation: Backend test class TestReferralFlow created 1 TEST_ref_* signup tenant + its user + affiliate referral doc; all deleted in test_cleanup_created_signup. Also created 2 synthetic TEST_refr_* / TEST_refrx_* referrer tenants inside _grant_referral_free_month tests and deleted them at test end. Frontend BlogManager test created 'TEST UI Article ITER106' blog post via UI and deleted it via UI. No residual TEST_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter106_blog_referral.py runs in 3.5s and is fully self-contained (needs MONGO_URL + DB_NAME env). Blog seed happens lazily on first GET /public/blog. To retest referral end-to-end more realistically, invoke rzp_verify directly against a mock signature or hit _grant_referral_free_month as this suite does. Frontend Partners tab lives behind super-nav-more menu; on desktop it's already visible in the sidebar list — click [data-testid=super-tab-partners]. Settings page and /refer both require Owner PIN 4321 double-unlock (page-level, then inner card).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Copy mismatch on /refer step-3 is a minor copy update, not a bug.
